display.purpose: Route titles and short hierarchy cues; never dense data.

body.purpose: Species, forms, tables, controls, and competitive analysis.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Suppress transitions and scrolling motion for users who request it.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The red next action, with touch, focus, disabled, and fine-pointer feedback.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #a61020; border-radius: 2px; background: #a61020; color: #fff; font: 700 1rem/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; touch-action: manipulation; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #005fcc; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #8f1220; } }

components.name: Field
components.description: A readable white field with a full-size touch target.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #111; font: 600 1rem/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #111; border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; color: #111; font: 400 1rem/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; touch-action: manipulation; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #005fcc; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A dark shell link whose red underline identifies the current route.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 10px; border-bottom: 2px solid #a61020; color: #fff; font: 600 1rem/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #005fcc; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Type Badge
components.description: A type-tinted tag at 20% opacity with dark text and a crisp edge.
components.css: .ds-type-badge { min-height: 26px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid #7f9281; border-radius: 2px; background: rgb(126 184 100 / 20%); color: #111; font: 600 .875rem/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Species Row
components.description: A ruled catalog entry that keeps sprite, number, name, form, and type in one scan.
components.css: .ds-species-row { min-height: 88px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 58px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid #bbb9b3; color: #111; text-decoration: none; } .ds-species-art { width: 54px; height: 54px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #bbb9b3; background: #e8e6e0; } .ds-species-copy { display: grid; gap: 2px; font: 400 1rem/1.35 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-species-copy small { color: #484a4b; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-species-copy strong { font-weight: 700; } .ds-species-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #005fcc; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Competitive Result
components.description: A calculator result separated by rules, with the numeric outcome highlighted in red.
components.css: .ds-result { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #a61020; border-left-width: 4px; background: #fff; color: #111; font: 400 1rem/1.45 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-result strong { color: #a61020; font: 700 1.5rem/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A competitive field guide that leads with species discovery and exact-form reading, then supports team and battle analysis with clear controls and source-aware data.
keyCharacteristics: Bitmap display with neutral sans-serif data
Search and comparison lead each workflow
Flat rows and rules replace repeated floating cards

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Red marks a meaningful next action or selected result; it does not decorate every surface.

rules.name: The Readable Data Rule
rules.body: Keep species, forms, moves, periods, and inputs in the body face at a 1rem base.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A data region earns a border or tint only when it separates a task, state, or input group.

dos: Keep provenance and period visible beside usage data.
Preserve keyboard focus, pressed feedback, and reduced motion.
Tie each sprite to its exact form.
donts: Do not imply general Pokédex data proves Champions legality.
Do not use bitmap type for dense rows or labels.
Do not reuse reference-site assets or layouts.
